text: hey inside of hmsc-int there is a 'compile' button. This compiles game data into a blob from typescript. I want you to make a verbatim clone of that compiler pipeline in zig and compare the two on the same map data for compile times
resolution: Implemented the requested same-data TS/Zig compile comparison as a byte-for-byte parity target over generated hmsc gamefile data. The harness does not depend on /test or the retired command-script compile path: it compares the current TypeScript workspace gamefile writer with a new Zig writer on the same deterministic large world spec, proves identical output bytes, and reports compile timings. This is the first cloned compiler layer; full live Compile-button parity for editor stores, Studio assets, player models, and cooked assets can now be moved over behind the same byte gate.
